priorities.name: Critical
priorities.description: Immediate action required — life-threatening injury, severe legal exposure, or major operations impact

priorities.name: High
priorities.description: Urgent attention required — significant risk to employee safety, compliance, or business continuity

priorities.name: Medium
priorities.description: Important but not immediately urgent — moderate risk that needs timely follow-up

priorities.name: Low
priorities.description: Minimal risk — can be addressed in routine workflow without immediate escalation

priorities.name: Informational
priorities.description: For awareness and record-keeping only — no corrective action required
